config_verbatim:
# The confound-separating cell.
#
# NOTE: the chunker is `capped-whole-5000`, not `whole-document`. The
# embedding server serves Nemotron-3-Embed-1B with a 4096-token per-slot
# context and a 2048-token ubatch, so 4,748 of 129,375 documents (3.67%)
# cannot be embedded whole. They are SPLIT (zero overlap), not truncated, so
# this arm holds exactly the same text as the chunked arms -- see the
# CHUNKERS entry in harness/cli.py. Costs 1.057 chunks/node against 1.000.
#
# `redstring-native` differs from `vss-control` in TWO ways at once: the
# embedding model (ada-002 1536d -> Nemotron 2048d) and the chunking
# (whole-document -> boundary-preference). A gap between them cannot be
# attributed to either.
#
# This config holds the chunking fixed at whole-document, matching
# vss-control, and varies only the embedding model. vss-control minus this
# is the model's contribution; this minus redstring-native is chunking's.
#
# Shares one chunk table with redstring-native -- same model, same
# dimension and prefixes, so ADR 0002 and 0043 are satisfied -- and is
# isolated from it by tenant_id, which is derived from `name`.
name: native-wholedoc
dataset: prime
split: test-0.1
chunker: capped-whole-5000
embeddings: Nemotron-3-Embed-1B
dimension: 2048
aggregation: max
agent: dense
k: 20

# nomic-embed-text-v1.5 is asymmetric: it was trained with these exact task
# prefixes and expects them at inference. Omitting them is silent -- the
# vectors are well-formed and score plausibly, just worse than the model can
# do -- which is why every nomic config states them rather than relying on a
# default.
document_prefix: "passage: "
query_prefix: "query: "
